title: Symrise opens Northwest Arkansas Food Studio: expanding customer collaboration & culinary innovation in North America
summary: — Culinary-forward space designed to accelerate innovation and deepen customer collaboration in North America — To enhance speed and partnership development via hands-on co-creation and rapid prototyping — A kitchen-first, hospitality-driven environment, offering immersive tasting, live demos, and real-time concept development beyond traditional lab settings
